title: Former Malaysia PM Najib Razak's US$12.3 million fine paid by UMNO, paving way for house arrest
paragraphs: Former Malaysia PM Najib Razak's US$12.3 million fine paid by UMNO, paving way for house arrest
The "solidarity fund" set up for former Malaysian Prime Minister Najib Razak had reached the target amount, UMNO said.

KUALA LUMPUR: Former Malaysian Prime Minister Najib Razak's United Malays National Organisation (UMNO) party said on Friday (Nov 6) that it has paid the RM50 million (US$12.3 million) fine imposed on him, paving the way for him to serve the remainder of his prison sentence under house arrest as part of a conditional pardon granted by Malaysia’s king.
